title: ConServe: Fine-Grained GPU Harvesting for LLM Online and Offline Co-Serving
technique: SLO-aware token-level scheduler + layer-wise preemption + incremental KV checkpointing to co-serve online and offline requests

optimized_metrics.evidence: offline serving often involves processing large corpora ..., where the first-order performance metric is throughput that measures how many tokens are generated per second.
it is critical for an online LLM serving system to optimize both TTFT and TBT under stringent SLOs. For example, an online chatbot may set a 99th-percentile (P99) TTFT SLO of 1.5 seconds
a P99 TBT SLO of 100 milliseconds to respond faster than a typical human can read
ConServe can trade-off offline throughput for stricter online SLO adherence, enabling >99% TTFT and TBT attainment in all settings when s > 1
LLM service providers always strive to offer low-latency services while maximizing their GPU utilization

headline_claim.text: ConServe delivers an average of 2.2x higher throughput and reduces online serving tail latency by 2.9x on average compared to state-of-the-art systems.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: time to first token (TTFT), which is the duration of the prefill phase, and time between tokens (TBT), which is the execution time of each step in the decode phase
metric_definitions.notes: footnote: TBT is measured per token and is stricter than TPOT, which averages TBT per request

metric_definitions.definition_quote: throughput that measures how many tokens are generated per second
metric_definitions.notes: offline requests only; units K tokens/s

metric_definitions.definition_quote: SLO_TTFT/TBT(s) = s · P99_TTFT/TBT, dictating the allowed latency increase over Online-Only
metric_definitions.notes: SLO anchored to P99 of Online-Only baseline

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Utilization is defined as the offered load relative to the GPU's maximum achievable load.

slo_spec: P99 TTFT/TBT targets set from P99 latencies of Online-Only baseline; SLO scale s multiplies these (s=1 to larger); attainment reported (>99% for s>1, >=86% at s=1)
load_regime: synthetic online request-rate sweep (CV 0.5, 4096 in/256 out) plus BurstGPT trace replay, with saturating offline backlog
tradeoff_acknowledged: stricter online SLO reduces offline throughput (ConServe reaches avg 82.3% of optimal offline throughput; 93% at s=1.5)
workloads: BurstGPT online trace; offline datasets (Table 1); synthetic
extractor_notes: Dual objective: maximize offline throughput subject to online P99 TTFT/TBT SLOs. Framing as 'objective' vs 'constraint' is a judgement; scheduler explicitly 'maximizing throughput' within SLO slack.
